    #define ANA_REG5   (SYS_BASE + 0x45*4)  /* 0x44010114, pwdaudpll=bit13 */

       ana_write (ANA_REG25, 0xC2A0AE86);   /* config */
       ana_setbit(ANA_REG25, 18, 1); up_mdelay(1); ana_setbit(ANA_REG25, 18, 0); /* trigger 脉冲 */

       val &= ~AUD_RATE_ADC_MASK; val |= AUD_RATE_ADC_16K | AUD_APLL_SEL;
